subject: Elara Health — post-demo alignment & POC plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@elarahealth.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Elara Health — post-demo alignment & POC plan

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for the demo today — appreciate you walking us through the use-cases and the sample documents. Quick recap and a lightweight POC plan so we can move to commit:

Summary from the call:
- Primary goal: Validate Redwood’s inference latency/cost profile on Elara’s triage/triage-summarization pipeline and ensure acceptable hallucination/recall on clinical notes.
- Data: 5k de-identified notes (sample) for an initial pass.
- Stakeholders: Samantha (Clinical PM), Tom (Engineering lead), Laura (Procurements), Marcus (Solutions).

Proposed POC (4-week, light scope) — draft acceptance criteria and owners:
1) Week 0 (pre-run) — Security & access: Elara to provide data sample + complete minimal security intake questionnaire. Owner: Tom (Elara). Due: 2026-07-16.
2) Week 1 — Baseline run: Redwood runs the batch on 5k notes; measure P95 latency, token cost. Owner: Marcus (Redwood). Due: 2026-07-23.
3) Week 2 — Quality pass: Evaluate recall/hallucination on 200 annotated notes (Elara provides annotations). Owner: Samantha (Elara) + Marcus. Due: 2026-07-30.
4) Week 3 — Optimization: Apply recommended quantization/batching and re-run. Owner: Marcus (Redwood). Due: 2026-08-06.
5) Week 4 — Final metrics & handoff: Final report + decision meeting. Owner: Kimberly (Redwood) / Samantha. Due: 2026-08-13.

Success criteria (proposal):
- P95 latency <= 450ms on median-length notes (current baseline target).
- Quality: >= 88% recall on the annotated sample; no critical hallucinations in the safety sweep.
- Cost: projected per-note inference cost within the threshold you specified on the call (Tom, you mentioned ~$0.02/note as a target).

Open items we need to progress (ask list):
- Security questionnaire: I’ve attached a stub (redwood-soc2-evidence-stub.pdf) — please confirm who will be the point for this.
- Data sample: Please send the de-identified CSV sample (data-sample-spec.csv) or a secure link.
- SSO/SSO provisioning: If you plan to test single-sign-on in the private environment, let us know which IdP you’re using.

Attachments: POC-scope-v1.pdf (draft scope), redwood-soc2-evidence-stub.pdf, data-sample-spec.csv (spec).

Next steps we propose:
- Tom: share sample and confirm security contact by 2026-07-16.
- Samantha & Tom: quick sign-off on acceptance criteria; reply inline with any redlines.
- Marcus: will schedule the baseline run and confirm infra needs.

I’ll drop a shared Drive link with the scope and a HubSpot deal for tracking. If that plan looks good I’ll send calendar invites for the checkpoints.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai
(Attachment: POC-scope-v1.pdf)
From: Samantha Cole <samantha@elarahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@elarahealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Elara Health — post-demo alignment & POC plan

Kimberly — thanks for the clear plan. A few quick notes from our side: 

- The acceptance criteria look reasonable; one tweak: can we change the quality threshold to >= 90% recall for the annotated sample? Our clinical team is sensitive here and prefers a slightly higher bar before pilot sign-off.
- On data: we can deliver the 5k de-identified notes, but the engineering team needs to confirm the CSV layout; I’ll attach a sample by EOD Monday (2026-07-13).
- SSO: we use Okta for our IdP; Tom will send the SAML metadata.
- Security questionnaire: we have an internal reviewer (me) but Laura will handle procurement/contract side.

Two asks for Redwood:
1) Can Marcus confirm whether you need private VPC connectivity for the baseline run or if hosted endpoints are fine for the 5k batch?
2) If Redwood will attempt any quantized runs in Week 3, please note that we need a tiny compute window (we can provide a test node if needed).

Thanks — I’ll get the sample and Tom’s note shortly.

— Samantha
Clinical Program Manager, Elara Health
(samantha@elarahealth.com)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@elarahealth.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Elara Health — post-demo alignment & POC plan

Samantha — great, thanks for the quick reply and the suggested change. We’re fine moving the recall target to >= 90% for the annotated sample. Updated plan below and a small editset attached (POC-scope-v1.1.pdf).

Answers to your asks:
- Hosting: For the baseline (5k batch) hosted endpoints are fine and faster to stand up; Redwood will route the job to hosted capacity unless you request VPC connectivity. If you want the VPC runway we can provision but it adds ~3 business days for networking/config (flag that now if you want it). Owner: Marcus.
- Quantized runs: Yes, we will do a quantization/optimization pass in Week 3. If Elara can provide a test node that helps verify performance characteristics; otherwise we’ll use Redwood’s reserved nodes. Either works.

Updated timeline highlights:
- Security intake & sample: due 2026-07-16 (Tom)
- Baseline run scheduled for 2026-07-23 (Marcus will confirm time)
- Annotated review due 2026-07-30 (Samantha)

I’ve attached POC-scope-v1.1.pdf which reflects the recall target and minor timeline tweaks. Will follow up with calendar invites for the baseline and final readout.

Thanks — Kim

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: POC-scope-v1.1.pdf)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-14T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Elara POC infra note

Kim / Laura — quick internal note:
- For the baseline 5k batch, we can run on hosted capacity without warmup but recommend a reserved slot for the quality pass to keep latency stable. I’ll request two warm spare slots on 2026-07-23 to be safe (shouldn’t affect other reservations).
- If Tom wants VPC, we need a networking window; flag now.

I’ll coordinate with infra to schedule the warm spare and confirm cost delta (small).

— Marcus
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@elarahealth.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly nudge: Elara POC — items to close this week

Hi all — small weekly nudge as we approach the pre-run window. Summary of outstanding items and who’s on point: 

Checklist (please reply with ✅ when done):
- [ ] Security questionnaire completed (redwood-soc2-evidence-stub.pdf) — Owner: Tom / Samantha — target: 2026-07-16 (overdue)
- [ ] Data sample (5k de-id notes) uploaded to secure link — Owner: Tom — target: 2026-07-16 (overdue)
- [ ] SAML metadata for Okta sent to Marcus — Owner: Tom — target: 2026-07-16 (overdue)
- [ ] Confirm if you want VPC connectivity for the baseline run — Owner: Samantha/Tom — target: 2026-07-16
- [ ] Marcus to confirm baseline run time on 2026-07-23 — Owner: Marcus — target: 2026-07-15

Notes: I realize a few deadlines slipped — if we can get the three items above by end of day Tuesday (2026-07-20) we’ll still hit the baseline window. If any blocker remains, please call me and we’ll re-plan the timeline.

For visibility I’ve added the HubSpot checklist here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 and the scope in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/poc-readme.

Thanks — appreciate the momentum.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
